- Provides cost-aware defaults and guidance for stable open-source and frontier model workflows.
- Documents memory structure for routing profiles, provider setup, incident tracking, and budget control.
- Outlines practical setup steps, core routing rules, and common pitfalls to avoid.
- Ensures all authentication stays secure and local; secrets never exposed in chat or memory files.
